notes: [[title:What's new]] Segue just crossed 10,000 downloads. Honestly insane. Thank you. I appreciate every single one of you that donates or sends kind words. I see every single one. 🫶 [[new]] In-app updater. A lot of you asked for this. Segue can now update itself right inside the app, seamlessly. No reinstall needed. This is the last download you grab by hand: from here Segue keeps itself up to date. [[img:https://github.com/Segueapp/segue-releases/raw/main/images/1.4.3/Downloader.png]] [[improved]] Code signed, finally. After a lot of back and forth with different signing providers, Segue is now properly code-signed. On the latest version the trojan warnings should disappear, and the SmartScreen and Defender warnings should fade away soon too. [[img:https://github.com/Segueapp/segue-releases/raw/main/images/1.4.3/code_signed_sig_big.png]] More on the way. I have been working on a ton of good stuff. Stay tuned.
headline: Code signed + in-app updates
